div.head: Wl Edmr 2.3
div.ab: Nulli nihilominus episcoporum suorum concessum iri permittebat, ut aliquem de baronibus suis seu ministris, siue incestu siue adulterio siue aliquo capitali crimine denotatum, publice nisi eius præcepto implacitaret aut excommunicaret aut ulla ecclesiastici rigoris pena constringeret.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 520 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: ab hoc vinculo anathematis absolvere te non possum, nisi misericordiam regis requiras schreibt Lanfranc dem Grafen Roger von Hereford; Böhmer p. 94. Noch 1205 beschwören die Barone der Normandie als deren Herzogsrecht: kein Kirchenoberer darf des Königs Barone oder Beamte excommuniciren, ohne König oder Seneschall zu befragen; Round Calendar of docum. in France n. 1318

ab hoc vinculo anathematis absolvere te non possum, nisi misericordiam regis requiras writes Lanfranc to Earl Roger of Hereford; Böhmer p. 94. As late as 1205 the barons of Normandy swear as its duke’s right: no ecclesiastical superior may excommunicate the king’s barons or officials without consulting the king or the seneschal; Round Calendar of docum. in France n. 1318
